{{Top|leg}}
'''Botha Ammunitions Corporation''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]-owned company. It produced [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power packs]] and [[blaster gas canister/Legends|blaster gas canisters]].

It was based on the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], its installations being in the south-eastern part of the [[Arblis Forest]] on the [[planet/Legends|planet]]'s main continent.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

They mined gases from the [[Both system|system's]] [[gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] and refined them in their private [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation orbiting station|orbiting station]]. The gases were collected by the company's fleet of vessels, and returned to Kothlis.<ref name="GR">''{{WEGCite|story=Garbage Run|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}''</ref><ref name="guide" />

Its largest client was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While it monitored all the company's activities, the Empire was unable to detect Bothamco's deal with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]: some packs and canisters were purposefully marked as defective or damaged, and discarded, then collected by the [[Ukert]]'s [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] of [[Reclamation Services, Inc.]] along with the recyclabes. Ukert then, who had a double career as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], supplied the Rebels with them, and shared the profits with BAC, through secret channels.</ref><ref name="guide" />
